title: Not Sot if that’s what you need
text:
Not Sot if that’s what you need. This pillow was listed as Extra Soft but it is hard as a Rock! I sent it back and finally settled on the Comfort Hi-Lo Adaptable
By Tempurpedic . It’s great if you want soft but still adaptable support. The only negative is that I ordered a Queen and got a Standard size but it is OK for me.

product_metadata.title: Tempur-Pedic TEMPUR-Cloud Soft & Lofty Queen Size Pillow, Medium Soft Support Washable Cover, White
features: TEMPUR MATERIAL - Filled with TEMPUR microcushions to comfortably cradle head and neck. The Medium-soft feel provides huggable comfort.
PERFECTED FOR YOU - Tempur-Pedic pillows are made with pressure-relieving material, formulated by NASA, and perfected by us for a perfect night’s rest.
5 YEAR LIMITED WARRANTY - Adaptive TEMPUR material offers personalized support and alignment and returns to its formed shape after each use.

WASHABLE & REMOVABLE COVER - Premium quilted cotton cover is soft and breathable and can be easily removed and washed. Designed with 100% Cotton Quilted Outside Cover with 50% cotton, 50% polyester backing that is removable and washable
ASSEMBLED IN THE USA - The Tempur-Pedic TEMPUR-Cloud Soft & Lofty Pillow is intended for back, side or stomach sleepers. The Queen size measures 27" L x 19" W x 6.5" H.

YOUR NEW PILLOW - Getting Acquainted with your new product: Your new pillow may feel more firm than expected. We recommend sleeping on it for a few weeks in order to give your pillow a chance to “break-in” to the way you sleep. As with most new purchases, any “new product smell” that you may experience is harmless and will dissipate in a couple of weeks.
description: The TEMPUR-Cloud- Soft and Lofty Pillow is cushion soft for huggable comfort. Filled with TEMPUR microcushions to comfortably cradle head and neck.  So whether you're a back, side or stomach sleeper, you'll be perfectly comfortable. This cushion-soft pillow offers huggable comfort and TEMPUR material microcushions that perfectly cradle your head, neck and shoulders in any sleep position, and returns to its lofty shape after each useIt's 100% quilted cotton cover is not only soft and breathable, but also removable and washable. This pillow will hold its shape, without flattening out for years of use. This Queen version of the TEMPUR-Cloud- Soft and Lofty Pillow perfectly fits a Queen pillow case. Backedy by a 5-year limited warranty. The Queen Sizes measures 27" L x 19" W x 6.5" H
